primitive: REG_OLS penalty l2 / l1 / elasticnet: glmnet's standardize = FALSE objective, intercept unpenalised
r_function: s * coef(glmnet(x, y / s, gaussian, weights, alpha = alpha', lambda = lambda', standardize = FALSE, control = list(thresh = 1e-24, maxit = 1e8)))
note: Pulse alpha / l1_ratio map to glmnet lambda' / alpha' on the unit-SD response y/s (s the weighted population SD): lambda' = alpha*(1 - r) + alpha*r/s, alpha' = (alpha*r/s)/lambda'. rows are [predictors..., y, w]; N* = sum(w). Every case is self-checked against the KKT conditions of the stated objective at relative 1e-10. l2 cases add std_errors / p_values / df: the closed-form ridge covariance sigma2 * A^-1 G A^-1 (A = G + N* alpha I, G the weighted centred Gram, sigma2 = RSS/(N* - p - 1)), Var(b0) = sigma2/N* + mu' V mu, Student-t p on N* - p - 1 df, computed by R matrix algebra (ridge_inference). l1 / elasticnet cases carry no inference: their standard errors and p-values are undefined (null in Pulse).
